title: Torrential rain causes widespread flooding in South Florida
summary: Entire neighbourhoods remain under water as disruptions impact schools, roads, hospitals and airports.
text: Watch: Widespread flooding in South Florida after heavy rainfall - BBC News BBC Homepage Skip to content Accessibility Help Your account Home News Sport Earth Reel Worklife Travel Culture Future Music TV Weather Sounds More menu More menu Search BBC Home News Sport Earth Reel Worklife Travel Culture Future Music TV Weather Sounds Close menu BBC News Menu Home Climate World US & Canada UK Business Tech Science Entertainment & Arts Health More In Pictures BBC Verify Newsbeat US & Canada Torrential rain causes widespread flooding in South Florida Torrential rain causes widespread flooding in South Florida Close Entire neighbourhoods remain flooded across Southern Florida after heavy overnight rainfall on Tuesday night. More than a foot of rain hit some parts of the region, according to the National Weather Service. Disruptions have impacted schools, roads, hospitals and airports. In Hollywood, Florida, a synagogue roof collapsed due to the rain. Additional rainfall is expected through the week.
